title: The Chameleon Nature of LLMs: Quantifying Multi-Turn Stance Instability in Search-Enabled Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-turn stance instability (chameleon behavior) by tracking how often search-enabled models shift their positions (e.g., supportive, critical, balanced) when presented with contradictory probing queries. This is measured using a novel Chameleon Benchmark Dataset, an LLM-as-a-judge stance analyzer, and metrics like the Chameleon Score and Source Re-use Rate.
